name: Dr. Marit Juuso
post: physician, Ealat colony infirmary, Hesker IV

traits: impatient with what she calls the herders' old talk
persona.tired_of: doing three people's work in an infirmary built for a village
persona.wrong_about: that the sickness is native to Hesker IV and the reedflies carry it
persona.cares_about: her daughter's first year at Starfleet Medical Academy, about which she writes long letters she doesn't send

toward.eira: A hard mother of a very sick boy.

agenda.goal: Burn the reedfly marshes on the Ninth before the herds come down
agenda.next_step: get the council's authority and ask the Enterprise for help with the burn

agenda.goal: Keep the nine children in her infirmary alive
agenda.next_step: beg the Enterprise for cardiac support she doesn't have

relationships.sara: Council speaker; they have fought for eleven years and need each other.
relationships.eira: Her son Jovnna is in bed four.

schedule.all: the infirmary at Javri; she sleeps there

competence.instruments: a human-pathogen database and a field lab; no veterinary records
